about: Research questions per focus, pre-filled into each agent's brief by `dh research brief` (placeholders come from the brief). Each question is an evidence spec: TARGET (what to find), PRIMARY (where it really lives), DONE_WHEN (stop), FRESH (changes over time: always search, never memory).

by_shape.why: research asks what fits the business shape; a shape not listed keeps the full bar (3 competitors, conversion plays, verified quotes)

internal.about: a tool for the owner's own team: no competitors to beat, no visitors to convert

questions.target: 3-5 real businesses selling {business} to {audience} in {market}: name, site, one-line promise
questions.primary: each competitor's own site (not directories or listicles)
questions.done_when: 3 opened sites, each with its promise quoted

questions.target: per competitor: 2 things that convert (instant quote, same-day slots, guarantee, reviews) and 1 gap
questions.primary: their home, services and booking pages
questions.done_when: 2 strengths + 1 gap per competitor, each quoted

questions.target: how {business} is priced in {market}: the unit (hour, room, m², visit, plan) and the anchor prices
questions.primary: competitors' own pricing or quote pages
questions.done_when: prices from 3 competitors, each quoted with its unit

questions.target: add-ons, minimums, recurring discounts, cancellation fees
questions.done_when: what 2 competitors charge extra for, quoted

questions.target: what {audience} complain about and praise when buying {business} in {market}, in their own words
questions.primary: reviews (Google, Trustpilot, local directories), forums, Reddit
questions.done_when: 5 pains or praises, each quoted verbatim

questions.target: why they buy (the trigger: moving out, new baby, guests, office opening)
what the best {business} sites in {market} show before scrolling: offer, proof, the main action
questions.done_when: the first screen of 3 competitors described from their own text

questions.target: how a visitor becomes a customer: instant quote, booking calendar, call, form; what trust proof sits next to it
the words people in {market} type to find {business} (service + place, questions, comparisons)
questions.primary: the titles and headings of pages that rank, search suggestions, 'people also ask'
questions.done_when: 8 search phrases seen on real result pages

questions.target: which page types rank for those words (service page, city page, guide, directory)
questions.done_when: the page type of the top results for 3 phrases

questions.target: licences, insurance, certifications and consumer rules for {business} in {market} (price display, cancellation rights, taxes)
questions.done_when: each rule quoted from an official page, or NOT_FOUND with what was tried

questions.target: the exact words customers, professionals and ranking pages use for {business} in {language}
questions.primary: competitor sites, trade bodies, job ads, reviews
questions.done_when: 8 terms, each copied from a real page with a quote containing it
